narrative.overview:
Every gathering is a ticket. A black lanyard (app bar, bottom tabs, rail, sidebar) holds warm card stock; each event is a pass with a colored top band, a dashed perforation, punched notches, and a 96px stub on the right. The stub is the action and the status; the row never restyles.

Density is phone-first and calm: one column of full-width passes at 360px, two columns from `lg`. Condensed caps print names, numbers and bands; a plain humanist sans carries the rest. Red means "act here". Gold is foil, never paint. The palette is pinned by REQUIREMENTS §11.1 and checked for WCAG 2.2 AA by `scripts/contrast.mjs`; light and dark are both first-class.
keyCharacteristics: Black shell in both modes; content on warm off-white (light) or near-black (dark).
Pass anatomy: 6px band, dashed stub divider, notches in the page color.
State lives in the stub: red fill, fill ramp, day/time, check.
Barlow Condensed caps for print; Public Sans for reading.

rules.name: The Lanyard Rule
rules.body: The shell is black in both modes; it never inverts with the theme.

rules.name: The Foil Rule
rules.body: Gold is foil on small labels and the focus ring on black. Never a fill for buttons or surfaces.

rules.name: The Reversed Band Rule
rules.body: In dark mode the church-wide band reverses to dark-band-church (light), never a grey.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: A marked stub fills from the bottom with stub-fill to the share checked in, over surface-2. No other quantity uses this ramp.

rules.name: The Contrast Gate Rule
rules.body: Any palette change is made in `globals.css` and passes `npm run contrast` (4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI, bands and rings).

rules.name: The Print Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is for names, numbers, bands and headings, always uppercase. Sentences and labels stay in Public Sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Times and counts use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Pass Rule
rules.body: Passes carry no shadow; their border and notches are the depth.

dos: **Do** put every state change in the stub; leave the pass body untouched.
**Do** keep touch targets at 44px or more (tabs 56px).
**Do** use the 2px outline with 2px offset for focus: pass-red on paper (light), gold in dark and on the shell.
**Do** list passes in time order and give future church-wide events their own "Coming up" section.
donts: **Don't** add per-card "Take attendance" buttons; the stub is the action.
**Don't** use gold as a fill for buttons or surfaces.
**Don't** grey out the church-wide band in dark mode.
**Don't** add a second animation or play the stamp on page load.
